fragments.text: Good morning, Kenton Festival box office. How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 早上好，这里是Kenton节假日售票处，请问有什么可以帮到您？

fragments.text: Oh, good morning. I'm coming to Kenton for a few days' holiday next month, and a friend told me there's a festival. She gave me this number to find out about it.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 早上好，下个月我会去Kenton度几天假，有个朋友告诉我那里有个节日。她给了我这个号码让我自己来问清楚。

fragments.text: That's right, the festival begins on the
and goes on till the 19th.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 是的，该节日从5月16号开始，持续到19号。

fragments.text: Oh, that's great. I'll be there from the
. So could you tell me the
, please?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 啊，太棒了，我会在那从15号待到19号。请你告诉我一下具体有什么节目。

fragments.text: Well, on the
there's the opening ceremony, in the town centre. People start gathering around
, to get a good place to see from, and the events will start at
, and finish about

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 嗯，第一天在市中心有个开幕式。为了找到一个看节目的好位置，人们两点左右就开始聚集，开幕式2:45开始，5:30左右结束。

fragments.text: OK, thanks. I'll make sure I get there early to get a good spot.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好的，谢谢，我会确保早点到那找个好位置的。

fragments.text: The festival will be opened
by the
. He'll just speak for a few minutes, welcoming everyone to the festival. All the town councillors will be there, and of course lots of other people.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 节日将由市长正式宣布开幕。他会发表几分钟的讲话，欢迎大家来参与这个节日。所有的市议员都会出席，当然也还有很多别的人。

fragments.text: Right.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好。

fragments.text: Then there'll be a performance by a
. Most years we have a children's choir, but this year the
offered to perform, and they're very good.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 然后会有一个乐队的表演。大多数年份都有儿童合唱，但今年本地军校学员主动要来表演，他们非常棒。

fragments.text: Uhuh.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 哦，是吗？

fragments.text: After that, a
from the town will perform a play they've written themselves, just a short one. It's about Helen Tungate. I don't know if you've heard of her?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 在那之后，本地的一个社区团体将表演一出他们自己写的短剧。短剧是关于 Helen Tungate的。我不知道您是否听说过她。

fragments.text: I certainly have. She was a
years ago.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 我当然听过，她很多年前是位科学家。

fragments.text: That's right. She was born in Kenton exactly
so we're celebrating her centenary.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 是的，她正好在100年前生于 Kenton，所以我们会庆祝她的百年诞辰。

fragments.text: I'm a
so I've always been interested in her. I didn't
she came from Kenton.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 我是一个生物学家，所以我一直对她很感兴趣，不过我没意识到她来自 Kenton。

fragments.text: Yes. Well, all that will take place in the afternoon, and later, as the sun sets, there'll be a
. You should go to the park to watch, as you'll get the best view from there. And the display takes place on the
. It's always one of the most popular events in the festival.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 嗯，刚才说的所有节目都是在下午，随后，日落的时候将会有焰火表演。你应该去公园看的，那儿有最好的视野。焰火表演就在河对面。那一直是节日期间最受欢迎的活动之一。

fragments.text: Sounds great.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 听起来很赞。

fragments.text: And what's happening on the other days?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 其余那些天有什么节目呢？

fragments.text: There are
that go on the whole time. For example, the students of the art college have produced a number of videos, all connected with
between children and their

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 节日期间有好几个活动。比如说，艺术学院的学生制作了很多视频， 都是关于祖孙关系的。

fragments.text: That sounds interesting. It makes a change from
doesn't it!

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 这听起来挺有趣的，同以前探讨父母与子女关系的不一样。

fragments.text: Exactly. Because the art college is in use for
, throughout the festival, the videos are being shown in Handsworth House.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 是的。因为艺术学院在节日期间要上课，所以视频是在 Handsworth House 放映的。

fragments.text: How do you spell the name?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 那个名字怎么拼？

fragments.text: . Handsworth House. It's close to the Town Hall.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: H-A-N-D-S-W-O-R-T-H. Handsworth House，就在市政厅附近。

fragments.text: Right.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: Now let me see, what else can I tell you about?

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 我想想看，还有别的什么能告诉您的？

fragments.text: Are there any displays of
? I'm particularly interested in that as I do it as a

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 有芭蕾舞表演吗？ 我对芭蕾尤其感兴趣，我自己也跳，当是爱好。

fragments.text: There isn't any ballet, I'm afraid, but there'll be a
of
from all round the country.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 恐怕没有芭蕾表演，但是有全国各地的传统舞蹈的汇演。

fragments.text: Oh, that'd be nice. Where's that being held?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 啊，太棒了，那在哪举行呢？

fragments.text: It's in the market in the town centre - the
one, not the covered market. And it's on at
every afternoon of the festival, apart from the first day.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 在市中心的市场里，室外的那个，不是室内的。除了第一天，节日期间的每天下午两点和五点开始。

fragments.text: Lovely. I'm interested in all kinds of dancing, so I'm sure I'll enjoy that!

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 太棒了！我对所有种类的舞蹈都感兴趣，我确信我会很享受那些表演的！

fragments.text: Mmm. I'm sure you will.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 嗯，我确信你会的。

fragments.text: And I'd really like to go to some
, if there are any.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 如果有音乐会的话，我也很想去看看。

fragments.text: Yes, there are
. Three performed by
, and one by local children.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 嗯，有的，有好几个。有三个是职业乐手的表演，还有一个是本地儿童的表演。

fragments.text: And where is it being held?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 那在哪举行的呢？

fragments.text: It's in the library, which is in Park Street. On
, at
in the evening.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 18号晚上6:30在公园街的图书馆举行。

fragments.text: I presume I'll need tickets for that.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 我想我应该要买票。

fragments.text: Yes. You can book online, or you can buy them when you arrive in Kenton. Either at the festival
, or from any shops displaying our logo in the windows.

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 是的，您可以在网上订，或者在您到Kenton的时候在节假日售票处或是任何窗口带有我们商标的商店买都行。

fragments.text: Well. I think that'll
for the whole of my stay in Kenton. Thank you so much for all your help.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好的。我想我在Kenton的那些天都会很忙了。非常感谢你的帮助。

fragments.text: You're welcome. I hope you

sentences.speaker: Man
sentences.translation: 不客气，希望您能享受在Kenton的时光。

fragments.text: Thank you. Goodbye.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 谢谢，再见。
